## Services
- Concept and industrial design (sketching, form development, CAD)
- Prototyping and field testing
- Technical packages, specs, BOMs, design for manufacturing
- Production support and factory liaison

## Categories
Backpacking tents, sleeping pads and bags, camp furniture, packs, luggage,
and technical hardgoods inside and outside the outdoor industry.
